answers.core: It's part of the Area implementation.
answers.workaround: It can be worked around by using `is_instance_valid()` to check if referenced nodes still exist. However, I don't think you should need to guard every `body_exited` code with `is_instance_valid()` in order to prevent the game from crashing during quitting.

title: Don't emit body_exited and area_exited signals while quitting the scene tree
